decontamination_notes: Real bug fix from nodejs/undici PR #5696 (issue #5695), merged 2026-08-19, after the training cutoffs of the models this suite targets; re-check upstream_merged against any newer model's cutoff before reusing. DecoratorHandler defined onBodySent as an empty method and omitted onRequestSent entirely, so composing any interceptor dropped both outgoing-request hooks; the redirect, retry and cache handlers shared the gap. The fix (4 handler files, system complexity) forwards both hooks through lib/handler/decorator-handler.js, redirect-handler.js, retry-handler.js and cache-handler.js. Repo sliced at the PR base commit (f387057b) with the standard undici slicing (lib/ + index.js + index-fetch.js + package.json + LICENSE; dependency-free, node-ts image, loopback servers) — note this is a DIFFERENT base than this suite's oss-undici-interceptors-origin task and the two fixes share no files-in-common semantics. Coverage: 3 fail_to_pass tests, each verified failing at base and passing after the gold patch — hooks surviving a plain DecoratorHandler wrapper, interceptors.retry(), and interceptors.redirect(), asserting exact chunk contents and call counts; 2 pass_to_pass guards pin the bare-Client hooks (already working) and response flow through wrapped handlers. Assertions compare chunk strings and counts from the tests' own dispatches, never library error text.

pass_to_pass.name: bare_client
pass_to_pass.cmd: node --test --test-name-pattern='vb hooks fire on a bare Client' vb_hooks_reg.test.cjs

pass_to_pass.name: responses_flow
pass_to_pass.cmd: node --test --test-name-pattern='vb responses still flow through DecoratorHandler' vb_hooks_reg.test.cjs
